value.rationale: The exact logical probability spectrum is a motivated central invariant in recent permutation-class limit-law research. Going from a merely dense set to the complete sharp rational set resolves an explicit natural gap, with every denominator realized by an explicit first-order sentence; it is not a routine numerical increment and works uniformly for arbitrary target rational.
